data.summary_en: StateHarness maintains project-evolution state without model-parameter updates, letting agents log issues/hypotheses, findings/decisions, repo relationships, and unfinished work, and retrieve affected callers, tests, and docs at runtime to improve long-horizon coding; on RefactorBench, full-chain completion rises from 29.4% to 35.3%, cleanup-check accuracy from 87.0% to 95.4%.
